stem:
Alok watches ice cubes on a plate. He writes two questions: "Why does nature keep changing?" and "Does ice melt faster on a warm plate or on a cold plate?"

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: "Does ice melt faster on a warm plate or on a cold plate?" is scientific because it is focused and can guide a careful check.
"Why does nature keep changing?" is already scientific because any curiosity question counts.
The ice question can guide observation or a fair test; the nature question is too broad to check.
Neither question is scientific, because both were written after watching ice.

teacher.key_rationale: A scientific question is focused and can guide observation or a test. The ice question can; the nature question is too broad. Writing after watching ice does not decide scientific status.
